scope: Structured positive-annotation required object facts; no general safety/negative-visibility claim
relative_budget_metric: Paired B-current score minus C-current score on the same known independent labels
severity: Existence contradiction or explicit front/rear/left/right opposite-direction answer
new_severe_rule: C severe and B not severe, including when B omitted a required fact

scoped_acceptance.scene_E2E: B->C positive in all three test scenes and upper scene CI for delta below zero
